✦ Our Sacred Journey ✦

The Heart of
Bhakti in Jharkhand

"Founded on the timeless teachings of Srila Prabhupada, ISKCON Jamshedpur has been a beacon of Krishna Consciousness for thousands of devotees and seekers across Jharkhand."

Nestled in the vibrant steel city of Jamshedpur, our temple is a divine sanctuary where Lord Krishna's eternal love manifests through daily worship, devotional service, and heartfelt community outreach. Since our establishment, we have been nurturing the spiritual growth of families, youth, and seekers throughout the greater Jharkhand region.

Our temple, dedicated to Shree Jagannath Mandir, follows the pristine Vaishnava traditions established by His Divine Grace A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada — the Founder-Acharya of ISKCON — who ignited this global spiritual revolution in 1966 and whose books and teachings continue to inspire millions worldwide.

✦ Our Mission ✦

Seven Purposes of ISKCON

Srila Prabhupada's divine vision to re-spiritualize society

Srila Prabhupada's plan to re-spiritualize society through the distribution of sanctified food is not mentioned in the original incorporation documents. Yet he established Food For Life and Govinda's vegetarian restaurants, and the Sunday Feast has become the weekly happening at every ISKCON center.

01

To systematically propagate spiritual knowledge to society at large and to educate all people in the techniques of spiritual life in order to check the imbalance of values in life and to achieve real unity and peace in the world.

02

To propagate a consciousness of Krishna (God), as it is revealed in the great scriptures of India, Bhagavad-gita and Srimad-Bhagavatam.

03

To bring the members of the Society together with each other and nearer to Krishna, the prime entity, thus developing the idea within the members, and humanity at large, that each soul is part and parcel of the quality of Godhead (Krishna).

04

To teach and encourage the sankirtana movement, congregational chanting of the holy name of God, as revealed in the teachings of Lord Sri Caitanya Mahaprabhu.

05

To erect for the members and for society at large a holy place of transcendental pastimes dedicated to the personality of Krishna.

06

To bring the members closer together for the purpose of teaching a simpler, more natural way of life.

07

With a view towards achieving the aforementioned purposes, to publish and distribute periodicals, magazines, books and other writings.

✦ ISKCON Founding Day ✦

Seven Purposes of ISKCON

The divine mission established by Srila Prabhupada on the day of ISKCON's founding

ISKCON Founding Day

Seven Purposes of ISKCON

Established by His Divine Grace A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada on the day of ISKCON's founding, these seven divine purposes guide our mission to spread spiritual knowledge and Krishna Consciousness throughout the world.

01
Purpose One

Spiritual Knowledge & World Peace

To systematically propagate spiritual knowledge to society at large and to educate all people in the techniques of spiritual life in order to check the imbalance of values in life, and to achieve real unity and peace in the world.

02
Purpose Two

Krishna Consciousness

To propagate a consciousness of Krishna as He is revealed in the Bhagavad-gītā and Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.

03
Purpose Three

Unity Through Bhakti

To bring the members of the Society together with each other and nearer to Krishna, the prime entity, thus developing the idea within the members, and humanity at large, that each soul is part and parcel of the quality of Godhead (Krishna).

04
Purpose Four

The Sankirtana Movement

To teach and encourage the saṅkīrtana movement, congregational chanting of the holy name of God, as revealed in the teachings of Lord Sri Chaitanya Mahāprabhu.

05
Purpose Five

Holy Places of Transcendental Pastimes

To erect for the members and for society at large a holy place of transcendental pastimes dedicated to the personality of Krishna.

06
Purpose Six

A Simpler, Natural Way of Life

To bring the members closer together for the purpose of teaching a simpler, more natural way of life.

07
Purpose Seven

Publish & Distribute Spiritual Literature

With a view towards achieving the aforementioned purposes, to publish and distribute periodicals, magazines, books and other writings.

🪷

"Simply by chanting the holy name of Krishna, one can be freed from all miserable conditions of material life. This is the easiest method of spiritual realization."

— His Divine Grace A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada

✦ Sacred Celebrations ✦

Divine Festivals & Grand Events

Experience the grandeur of Vaishnava festivals celebrated with devotion, community, and divine joy at ISKCON Jamshedpur

⭐ Grand Celebration
Krishna Janmashtami
The most awaited celebration — Lord Krishna's divine appearance. Midnight abhishek, spectacular kirtan, dramas, and festivities drawing thousands from across Jharkhand. The Jamshedpur ISKCON Janmashtami is legendary!
Annual Procession
Ratha Yatra
Grand chariot procession through the streets of Jamshedpur with thousands of devotees pulling the divine chariot of Lord Jagannath
Autumn Festival
Govardhan Puja
Annakut — massive food offering to Lord Krishna and Govardhan circumambulation with grand decorations
Divine Appearance
Radhastami
Celebration of Srimati Radharani's auspicious appearance day with special abhishek, kirtan and prasadam
Full Moon Festival
Guru Purnima
Kirtan Mela and glorification of the spiritual master with ecstatic chanting and devotional offerings
Festival of Lights
Deep Dan
Offering of countless lamps to the Deities — a mesmerizing sight of devotion and divine illumination
Youth & Community
Ceremony & Camping
Spiritual camping and ceremony programs for youth and families filled with kirtan, classes and prasadam
